name: Context menus help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Context menus plugin: the page, its tabs, every button, field, column and menu item.
author: Brett

entries.title: Context menus
entries.text: Every right-click menu of the app, kept once on axHub so every plugin and app reads the same menus. Generate them with Claude at a coder level, preview, apply, list, edit and restore.

entries.title: Generate
entries.text: The Generate tab (and the Generate… shortcut that opens it): pick a coder level, an app and optionally one page, then let Claude map the zones. You always get a draft to preview first.

entries.title: Drafts
entries.text: Generated menus waiting for your decision: preview each zone with the real menu renderer, see what changes, then Apply, Save without switching, or Discard.

entries.title: Menus
entries.text: Every context menu on the hub, grouped by app: which one is in use, its level, how many zones and items, who made it. Open a row for Preview, Edit, Restore and Delete.

entries.title: Zones
entries.text: Every right-click zone the code draws, with its owner plugin, weight and the pages that showed it. Rescan the code or report the current screen; with the UI Manager on, open a zone there.

entries.title: Coder level
entries.text: Beginner: a few big obvious actions. Amateur: the common actions. Pro: the full working set, grouped, with shortcuts. Advanced coder: a meticulous map of every zone with deep actions (tokens, API, inspect, copy ids, commands). Higher levels map the app more meticulously.

entries.title: App
entries.text: Which app the menus are for. The level can differ per app and page.

entries.title: Page
entries.text: Leave blank to map the whole app, or name one page to map only the zones that page shows.

entries.title: Menu name
entries.text: A name for the generated menu; blank lets Claude name it.

entries.title: Generate
entries.text: Sends the prompt to Claude and makes a draft. Spends Claude tokens; nothing is applied until you say so. Greyed out when Claude is not ready, with the reason above.

entries.title: Show the prompt
entries.text: Shows exactly what Claude will be asked for this level, app and page, without spending a token.

entries.title: Check Claude
entries.text: Runs the same tiny connection check the Claude badge shows green for, and says whether Generate can run.

entries.title: The prompt Claude gets
entries.text: The system and user prompt, read-only: the level brief, the zones to map and the actions a menu item may run.

entries.title: Apply and use
entries.text: Saves the draft as a menu on the hub and makes it the menu this app shows. Every open console follows.

entries.title: Save without switching
entries.text: Keeps the draft as a saved menu but leaves the app on the menu it shows now.

entries.title: Discard
entries.text: Throws the draft away. Nothing on the hub changes.

entries.title: Use
entries.text: Makes this menu the one its app shows.

entries.title: Preview
entries.text: Shows the menu zone by zone with the real menu renderer.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Edit the zones and items as JSON (zone to items; an item has id, label, icon, action, shortcut, items). Saving keeps the previous version as a snapshot.

entries.title: Restore
entries.text: Every snapshot of this menu, newest first; Restore puts one back, like a skin.

entries.title: Regenerate
entries.text: Asks Claude for a fresh draft at this menu's level and app.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Removes the menu from the hub. The app falls back to its own default menu if this one was in use.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves the edited zones and items; the previous version is kept as a snapshot.

entries.title: Reset
entries.text: Puts the editor back to the saved zones and items.

entries.title: Zones and items
entries.text: The menu as JSON: each zone maps to its items; an item has id, label, icon, action, shortcut and optional sub-items.

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Filters the menus by name, zone, action, level or who made them.

entries.title: Level filter
entries.text: Shows only the menus made at one coder level.

entries.title: Zone
entries.text: Which zone of the menu to preview.

entries.title: Filter zones
entries.text: Narrows the zone list by zone id, plugin or page.

entries.title: Rescan the code
entries.text: Reads the console, plugin and framework code again for every right-click zone it draws.

entries.title: Report this screen
entries.text: Tells the registry which zones the current screen shows, so generated menus know the pages and elements.

entries.title: Open in the UI Manager
entries.text: Opens the zone's element in the UI Manager to edit its properties and tokens.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reads the menus, drafts and zones from the hub again.

entries.title: Open Context menus
entries.text: Opens the Context menus page.

entries.title: Menu
entries.text: The menu's name and id; 'in use' marks the one its app shows.

entries.title: Level
entries.text: The coder level the menu was mapped at.

entries.title: Zones
entries.text: How many right-click zones the menu covers.

entries.title: Items
entries.text: How many items the menu holds across every zone.

entries.title: Made by
entries.text: Claude (with the model) or a person, and who saved it.

entries.title: Updated
entries.text: When the menu was last saved.

entries.title: Context menus…
entries.text: Opens the Context menus page from any right-click.

entries.title: Map this zone
entries.text: Opens the zone map on this zone and reports the current screen.

entries.title: Generate context menus
entries.text: Opens the Generate tab of the Context menus page.

entries.title: Context menus settings
entries.text: Where the menus live (axHub or this console's data folder), a shortcut to the page, and install / uninstall.

steps.say: Every right-click menu of the app lives here, once, on axHub.
Pick a coder level and press Generate: Claude maps the zones and you preview the draft before anything is applied.
Menus lists everything on the hub; Zones shows every right-click target the code draws.
